janiak2023polysemantic.title: Polysemantic Attention Head in a 4-Layer Transformer
janiak2023polysemantic.how: LessWrong page read 9 November 2026: title, three authors, posted 9 November 2023; attention-only 4-layer model; head 1.4 attends to an earlier token with similar indentation; on the bigger-indentation task the correct token is top-ranked in 100% of clean runs and 4% of corrupted runs.
